title: Verification: native replay of PR1868 twisted-helper words (no new kappa)
body:
PR1868 explicitly left native 5/9/11-stage replay unrun for its two twisted-helper words. This package closes that finite handoff: both absorbed words and their exact PR1062/1188 parents pass the unchanged, freshly compiled C++ checkers. Only `research/r439-twisted-native-audit/` is added.

The new Python harness independently reconstructs the three D/A edits, matches the complete exported record bytes, and checks local arbitrary-dirty boundaries and integer positive bounds. Each native schedule covers 883 / 1,327 / 1,549 input columns. All four words retain the same paid profile and rank mass 5,129. The candidate counts remain PR1868's 11,497 and 10,489 ADDs; those circuits and savings are Sagar Thakrar's result.

Validation: Python 3.12.13 registered replay under `-I -O -B`, Apple Clang 21 and Boost 1.87.0; twelve complete native runs; 192 inherited reduced-bank omitted-bridge controls; 18 additional dirty-state/frame/COPY/receipt controls; five package test groups including 168 receipt corruptions and minimal source-only relocation. Repository onboarding and replay-selection suites passed all 24 tests under Python 3.12. Exact sources, complete deterministic receipts, local environment and the registered-replay log are retained. All 15 published file blobs match the checked commit; hosted CI currently has 62 queued checks.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-twisted-native-audit
```

Requires the retained C++17/Boost environment (`CXX` / `BOOST_INCLUDE` may select it). The package fails if native dependencies are missing. The native programs establish F2 scalar staged execution and chronological frame/COPY legality separately; they do not execute physical address transforms on twisted helper values. The inherited bank-nondegeneracy receipt flag is explicitly identified as a fixed annotation, not fresh bank evidence. Helper climb-additivity, general twisted cleanup, hosted emission/invoice, all-size/compiler, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. No supplier adoption, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. Contribution head: `ebbeb8be3435f2dbeafceded4e3ddb6d3b6b8ee5`. PR1868 source head: `6b222d01fee072bcd3a680e6a96ae7d22e13bcac`, rechecked unchanged. [Scoped discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1886). Final overlap covered 551 open PRs and 532 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; the active symbolic-contract audit and multi-writer search are complementary.

Credit Sagar Thakrar/PR1868 and PR1062, Gareth Davidson/PR1188 and the PR1122 native harness, Dylan Crow/DaysSky and the retained checker lineage. Full predecessor notices and exact byte pins are preserved. Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; one agent and no independent human review. Apache-2.0.
